logger.doc:name: Log Accepted
logger.message: #["ACCEPTED opportunity $(payload.Id) modified $(payload.LastModifiedDate)"]

logger.doc:name: Log Published
logger.message: #["PUBLISHED to orders-queue: correlationId $(vars.queueEvent.correlationId) opportunity $(vars.queueEvent.payload.opportunityId)"]

logger.doc:name: Log Watermark
logger.message: #["WATERMARK saved: $(vars.queueEvent.payload.lastModifiedDate)"]

logger.doc:name: Log Skipped
logger.message: #["SKIPPED opportunity $(payload.Id) stage=$(payload.StageName default "")"]

logger.doc:name: Log Duplicate
logger.message: #["DUPLICATE ignored: opportunity $(payload.Id) version $(payload.LastModifiedDate)"]

logger.doc:name: Log Publish Failed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "PUBLISH FAILED corr=$(vars.corrId default "none") opp=$(vars.oppId default "none"): " ++ (vars.retryError default "unknown") ++ ". Replay with POST /api/orders/replay (opportunityId, force=true)"]

logger.doc:name: Log Key Not Removed
logger.message: Duplicate key could not be removed after the publish failure.

logger.doc:name: Log Consumed
logger.message: #["CONSUMED from orders-queue: correlationId $(payload.correlationId default "none") opportunity $(payload.payload.opportunityId default "none")"]

when.expression: #[not isEmpty(payload.correlationId default '') and not isEmpty(payload.payload.opportunityId default '') and not isEmpty(payload.payload.accountId default '') and not isEmpty(payload.payload.lastModifiedDate default '')]

logger.doc:name: Log Validated
logger.message: #["VALIDATED message: correlationId $(payload.correlationId) opportunity $(payload.payload.opportunityId)"]

choice.doc:name: Lines, amount and reference data OK?

logger.doc:name: Log No Lines
logger.message: #["BUSINESS ERROR corr=$(payload.correlationId) opp=$(payload.payload.opportunityId): opportunity has no line items"]

set-variable.value: Opportunity has no line items, no order was created
set-variable.doc:name: Message no lines

logger.doc:name: Log Amount Mismatch
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "BUSINESS ERROR corr=$(payload.correlationId) opp=$(payload.payload.opportunityId): amount mismatch, lines total $(vars.amountCheck.calculatedTotal) but opportunity amount $(vars.amountCheck.opportunityAmount), tolerance $(vars.amountCheck.tolerance)"]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- "Amount mismatch: line items total $(vars.amountCheck.calculatedTotal) but opportunity amount is $(vars.amountCheck.opportunityAmount), tolerance $(vars.amountCheck.tolerance)"]
set-variable.doc:name: Message amount mismatch

logger.doc:name: Log Missing Reference Data
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "BUSINESS ERROR corr=$(payload.correlationId) opp=$(payload.payload.opportunityId): missing reference data: $(vars.refCheck.message)"]

logger.doc:name: Log Amount OK
logger.message: #["AMOUNT OK corr=$(payload.correlationId) opp=$(payload.payload.opportunityId): $(vars.amountCheck.lineCount) lines total $(vars.amountCheck.calculatedTotal), matches opportunity amount $(vars.amountCheck.opportunityAmount)"]

logger.doc:name: Log Order Number
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "ORDER NUMBER corr=$(payload.correlationId) opp=$(payload.payload.opportunityId): $(vars.orderNumber default "none")"]

logger.doc:name: Log Canonical Order
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "CANONICAL ORDER corr=$(payload.correlationId) opp=$(payload.payload.opportunityId): " ++ write(vars.canonicalOrder, "application/json")]

logger.doc:name: Log Persisted
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "PERSISTED corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId): order $(vars.orderNumber) saved with $(vars.canonicalOrder.lineCount) lines"]

logger.doc:name: Log File Generated
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "FILE GENERATED corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId): $(vars.finalFileName)"]

logger.doc:name: Log Order Without File
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "ORDER KEPT WITHOUT FILE corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId) order=$(vars.orderNumber): file_status FILE_FAILED, write-back and email skipped"]

logger.doc:name: Log Not Persisted
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "ORDER NOT CREATED corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId): result $(vars.persistResult)"]

logger.doc:name: Log Invalid
logger.message: #["INVALID message sent to orders-dlq: correlationId $(payload.correlationId default "none")"]

logger.doc:name: Log System Error
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "SYSTEM ERROR corr=$(vars.corrId default "none") opp=$(vars.oppId default "none") (" ++ (vars.retryStatus default "UNKNOWN") ++ "): " ++ (error.description default "unknown")]

logger.doc:name: Log Sent To DLQ
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "SENT TO DLQ corr=$(vars.corrId default "none") opp=$(vars.oppId default "none"): message moved to orders-dlq"]

db:insert.doc:name: Record system exception
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO order_exception (opportunity_id, order_number, error_code, error_message, retry_count, correlation_id) VALUES (:opportunityId, NULL, :errorCode, :errorMessage, :retryCount, :correlationId)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ opportunityId: vars.oppId default "unknown", errorCode: if ((vars.retryStatus default "") == "PERMANENT") "SYSTEM_PERMANENT_ERROR" else if ((vars.retryStatus default "") == "AUTH_FAILED") "SF_AUTH_FAILED" else "SYSTEM_RETRY_EXHAUSTED", errorMessage: do { var m = (error.description default "") --- if (sizeOf(m) > 500) m[0 to 499] else m }, retryCount: (vars.retryAttempt default 0) as Number, correlationId: vars.corrId default "unknown" }]

logger.doc:name: Log Exception Not Recorded
logger.message: Could not record the system exception in the database (it may be down). The message is in orders-dlq.

logger.doc:name: Log Corrupt
logger.message: #["CORRUPT message sent to orders-dlq. Reason: " ++ (error.description default "unknown")]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- do { var m = (error.description default 'Unknown error') as String --- if (sizeOf(m) > 500) m[0 to 499] else m }]
set-variable.doc:name: Keep error reason

set-variable.value: #[upper((error.errorType.namespace default '') as String) ++ ':' ++ upper((error.errorType.identifier default '') as String)]
set-variable.doc:name: Keep error type

set-variable.value: #[(['sf-enrich-query-op-flow', 'sf-writeback-op-flow'] contains (vars.retryOpFlow default '')) and ((lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'invalid_login') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'invalid_session_id') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'invalid username, password') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'session expired') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'unauthorized') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'authentication') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'login_must_use_security_token') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'invalid_grant'))]
set-variable.doc:name: Detect Salesforce authentication error

set-variable.value: #[(lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'unable_to_lock_row') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'request_limit_exceeded') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'too many requests') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'timeout') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'timed out') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'connection reset') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'connection refused') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'broken pipe') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'temporarily unavailable') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'service unavailable') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'could not connect') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'deadlock detected') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'could not serialize access') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'http 429') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'http 502') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'http 503') or (lower(vars.retryError default '') contains 'http 504') or (lower(vars.retryErrorType default '') contains 'timeout') or (lower(vars.retryErrorType default '') contains 'connectivity')]
set-variable.doc:name: Detect transient error

logger.message: #['Salesforce authentication error; retrying operation once. This does not guarantee session refresh. Reason: ' ++ vars.retryError]
logger.doc:name: Log authentication retry

logger.message: #['Salesforce authentication retry failed. Manual authentication/configuration check required. Reason: ' ++ vars.retryError]
logger.doc:name: Log auth failure

set-variable.doc:name: Stop on permanent or unknown error

logger.message: #['Not retrying permanent or unclassified error. Type: ' ++ vars.retryErrorType ++ ', reason: ' ++ vars.retryError]
logger.doc:name: Log non-retryable error

logger.message: #['Retries exhausted. Operation: ' ++ (vars.retryOpFlow default 'unknown') ++ ', attempts: ' ++ ((vars.retryAttempt as Number) + 1) ++ ', reason: ' ++ vars.retryError]
logger.doc:name: Log retries exhausted

set-variable.value: #[(p('retry.delay.ms') as Number) * ([1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32][(vars.retryAttempt default 0) as Number] default 32)]
set-variable.doc:name: Calculate exponential backoff

logger.message: #['Transient error. Retrying operation ' ++ (vars.retryOpFlow default 'unknown') ++ ' after ' ++ (vars.retryDelayMs as String) ++ ' ms. Retry number: ' ++ ((vars.retryAttempt as Number) + 1) ++ '. Reason: ' ++ vars.retryError]
logger.doc:name: Log retry

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import java!java::lang::Thread output application/java --- Thread::sleep(vars.retryDelayMs as Number)

salesforce:query.doc:name: Query opportunity details
salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, Name, AccountId, StageName, Amount, CloseDate, OwnerId, Owner.Email, Pricebook2Id, ERP_Order_Number__c, Integration_Status__c, LastModifiedDate, SystemModstamp, Account.Name, Account.AccountNumber, Account.ShippingStreet, Account.ShippingCity, Account.ShippingState, Account.ShippingPostalCode, Account.ShippingCountry, (SELECT Id, Quantity, UnitPrice, TotalPrice, Product2Id, Product2.Name, Product2.ProductCode FROM OpportunityLineItems), (SELECT ContactId, Contact.Name, Contact.Email, Contact.Phone FROM OpportunityContactRoles WHERE IsPrimary = true) FROM Opportunity WHERE Id = ':oppId'

db:select.doc:name: Get next order number
db:select.db:sql: SELECT 'ERP-' || to_char(now(), 'YYYY') || '-' || LPAD(CAST(nextval('order_number_seq') AS TEXT), 6, '0') AS order_number

db:insert.doc:name: Insert order header
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO sales_order (order_number, opportunity_id, account_id, account_name, account_number, contact_name, contact_email, contact_phone, address_line1, city, state, postal_code, country, currency, total_amount, line_count, order_status, sf_last_modified, correlation_id) VALUES (:orderNumber, :opportunityId, :accountId, :accountName, :accountNumber, :contactName, :contactEmail, :contactPhone, :addressLine1, :city, :state, :postalCode, :country, :currency, :totalAmount, :lineCount, :orderStatus, CAST(:lastModified AS TIMESTAMP), :correlationId)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ orderNumber: vars.canonicalOrder.orderNumber, opportunityId: vars.canonicalOrder.opportunityId, accountId: vars.canonicalOrder.account.accountId, accountName: vars.canonicalOrder.account.accountName, accountNumber: vars.canonicalOrder.account.accountNumber, contactName: vars.canonicalOrder.account.contactName, contactEmail: vars.canonicalOrder.account.contactEmail, contactPhone: vars.canonicalOrder.account.contactPhone, addressLine1: vars.canonicalOrder.shippingAddress.addressLine1, city: vars.canonicalOrder.shippingAddress.city, state: vars.canonicalOrder.shippingAddress.state, postalCode: vars.canonicalOrder.shippingAddress.postalCode, country: vars.canonicalOrder.shippingAddress.country, currency: vars.canonicalOrder.currency, totalAmount: vars.canonicalOrder.totalAmount, lineCount: vars.canonicalOrder.lineCount, orderStatus: vars.canonicalOrder.orderStatus, lastModified: (vars.enriched[0].LastModifiedDate as DateTime) as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"}, correlationId: vars.canonicalOrder.correlationId }]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert order line
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO sales_order_line (order_number, line_number, product_code, product_name, quantity, unit_price, line_total) VALUES (:orderNumber, :lineNumber, :productCode, :productName, :quantity, :unitPrice, :lineTotal)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ orderNumber: vars.canonicalOrder.orderNumber, lineNumber: payload.lineNumber, productCode: payload.productCode, productName: payload.productName, quantity: payload.quantity, unitPrice: payload.unitPrice, lineTotal: payload.lineTotal }]

logger.doc:name: Log Duplicate Order
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "DUPLICATE ORDER corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId): an order already exists for this opportunity, nothing created"]

db:update.doc:name: Update order status
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE sales_order SET order_status = :status, file_name = CASE WHEN :fileName = '' THEN file_name ELSE :fileName END, updated_at = now() WHERE order_number = :orderNumber
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ status: vars.newStatus, fileName: vars.finalFileName default "", orderNumber: vars.orderNumber }]

logger.doc:name: Log Status
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "STATUS corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId) order=$(vars.orderNumber): $(vars.newStatus)"]

db:update.doc:name: Mark file GENERATED
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE sales_order SET file_status = 'GENERATED', updated_at = now() WHERE order_number = :orderNumber

logger.doc:name: Log File Failure
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "FILE WRITE FAILED corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId) order=$(vars.orderNumber): " ++ (error.description default "unknown")]

db:update.doc:name: Mark file FILE_FAILED
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE sales_order SET file_status = 'FILE_FAILED', updated_at = now() WHERE order_number = :orderNumber

salesforce:update.doc:name: Update opportunity
salesforce:update.salesforce:records: #[[{ Id: vars.oppId, ERP_Order_Number__c: vars.orderNumber, Integration_Status__c: "PROCESSED", Integration_Message__c: "Order created and file despatched", Fulfilment_Date__c: now() }]]

logger.doc:name: Log SF Result
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "SF UPDATE RESULT corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId): " ++ write(vars.sfResult, "application/json")]

db:update.doc:name: Mark SF_UPDATED
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE sales_order SET order_status = 'SF_UPDATED', sf_update_status = 'SUCCESS', updated_at = now() WHERE order_number = :orderNumber

logger.doc:name: Log SF_UPDATED
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "STATUS corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId) order=$(vars.orderNumber): SF_UPDATED"]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- do { var m = (error.description default "unknown") --- if (sizeOf(m) > 400) m[0 to 399] else m }]
set-variable.doc:name: Write-back failure reason

logger.doc:name: Log SF Failure
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "SF WRITE-BACK FAILED corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId): " ++ vars.wbReason]

db:update.doc:name: Mark SF write-back FAILED
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE sales_order SET sf_update_status = 'FAILED', updated_at = now() WHERE order_number = :orderNumber

salesforce:create.doc:name: Create write-back Task
salesforce:create.salesforce:records: #[output application/java --- [{ Subject: "Integration write-back failed: " ++ vars.orderNumber, WhatId: vars.oppId, OwnerId: vars.enriched[0].OwnerId, Description: "Order " ++ vars.orderNumber ++ " was created and the file was written, but updating this opportunity in Salesforce failed. Please reconcile manually. Reason: " ++ vars.wbReason, Status: "Not Started", Priority: "High" }]]

logger.doc:name: Log Write-back Task
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "SF WRITE-BACK TASK RAISED corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId) order=$(vars.orderNumber): " ++ write(vars.sfWbTaskResult, "application/json")]

db:insert.doc:name: Record write-back exception
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO order_exception (opportunity_id, order_number, error_code, error_message, retry_count, sf_task_id, correlation_id) VALUES (:opportunityId, :orderNumber, 'SF_WRITEBACK_FAILED', :errorMessage, :retryCount, :taskId, :correlationId)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ opportunityId: vars.oppId, orderNumber: vars.orderNumber, errorMessage: vars.wbReason, retryCount: (vars.retryAttempt default 0) as Number, taskId: (vars.sfWbTaskResult.items[0].id default ""), correlationId: vars.corrId }]

logger.doc:name: Log Task Not Raised
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "SF WRITE-BACK TASK NOT RAISED corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId) order=$(vars.orderNumber): " ++ (error.description default "unknown")]

db:update.doc:name: Mark NOTIFIED
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE sales_order SET order_status = 'NOTIFIED', email_status = 'SENT', updated_at = now() WHERE order_number = :orderNumber

logger.doc:name: Log Notified
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "STATUS corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId) order=$(vars.orderNumber): NOTIFIED"]

logger.doc:name: Log Email Failure
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "EMAIL FAILED corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId) order=$(vars.orderNumber): marked PENDING_RETRY, order stays SF_UPDATED. " ++ (error.description default "unknown")]

db:update.doc:name: Mark PENDING_RETRY
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE sales_order SET email_status = 'PENDING_RETRY', updated_at = now() WHERE order_number = :orderNumber

db:select.doc:name: Find orders to re-email
db:select.db:sql: SELECT order_number, opportunity_id, correlation_id, file_name, created_at, account_id, account_name, account_number, contact_name, contact_email, contact_phone, address_line1, city, state, postal_code, country, currency, total_amount, line_count FROM sales_order WHERE email_status = 'PENDING_RETRY' ORDER BY updated_at LIMIT :batchSize

logger.doc:name: Log Nothing Pending
logger.message: EMAIL RETRY JOB: nothing pending

logger.doc:name: Log Pending
logger.message: #["EMAIL RETRY JOB: $(sizeOf(payload)) order(s) pending"]

logger.doc:name: Log Job Failure
logger.message: #["EMAIL RETRY JOB FAILED: " ++ (error.description default "unknown")]

db:select.doc:name: Load order lines
db:select.db:sql: SELECT line_number, product_code, product_name, quantity, unit_price, line_total FROM sales_order_line WHERE order_number = :orderNumber ORDER BY line_number

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var r = vars.emailRow var fmt = (n) -> n as String {format: "0.##"} --- { orderNumber: r.order_number, orderDate: r.created_at as String, opportunityId: r.opportunity_id, account: { accountId: r.account_id, accountName: r.account_name, accountNumber: r.account_number default "", contactName: r.contact_name default "", contactEmail: r.contact_email default "", contactPhone: r.contact_phone default "" }, shippingAddress: { addressLine1: r.address_line1 default "", city: r.city default "", state: r.state default "", postalCode: r.postal_code default "", country: r.country default "" }, currency: r.currency, totalAmount: fmt(r.total_amount), lines: vars.orderLines map ((l) -> { lineNumber: l.line_number, productCode: l.product_code, productName: l.product_name default "", quantity: fmt(l.quantity), unitPrice: fmt(l.unit_price), lineTotal: fmt(l.line_total) }), lineCount: r.line_count, correlationId: r.correlation_id }

logger.doc:name: Log Owner Lookup Failed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "EMAIL RETRY OWNER LOOKUP FAILED corr=$(vars.corrId default "none") opp=$(vars.oppId default "none") order=$(vars.orderNumber default "none"): sending without owner CC. " ++ (error.description default "unknown")]

db:update.doc:name: Mark email SENT
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE sales_order SET order_status = CASE WHEN order_status = 'SF_UPDATED' THEN 'NOTIFIED' ELSE order_status END, email_status = 'SENT', updated_at = now() WHERE order_number = :orderNumber

logger.doc:name: Log Email Retry Sent
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "EMAIL RETRY SENT corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId) order=$(vars.orderNumber): email_status SENT"]

logger.doc:name: Log Email Retry Failed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "EMAIL RETRY FAILED corr=$(vars.corrId default "none") opp=$(vars.oppId default "none") order=$(vars.orderNumber default "none"): stays PENDING_RETRY, tried again next run. " ++ (error.description default "unknown")]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- do { var m = vars.businessErrorMessage default "" --- if (sizeOf(m) > 255) m[0 to 254] else m }]
set-variable.doc:name: Reason (255 chars)

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- do { var m = vars.businessErrorMessage default "" --- if (sizeOf(m) > 500) m[0 to 499] else m }]
set-variable.doc:name: Reason (500 chars)

logger.doc:name: Log Business Error Handling
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "BUSINESS ERROR HANDLING corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId) code=$(vars.businessErrorCode): $(vars.reason255)"]

db:insert.doc:name: Record exception
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO order_exception (opportunity_id, order_number, error_code, error_message, correlation_id) VALUES (:opportunityId, NULL, :errorCode, :errorMessage, :correlationId)

logger.doc:name: Log Exception Recorded
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "EXCEPTION RECORDED corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId) code=$(vars.businessErrorCode)"]

logger.doc:name: Log Opportunity Failed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "OPPORTUNITY FAILED corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId): Integration_Status__c set to FAILED"]

salesforce:create.doc:name: Create Task for owner
salesforce:create.salesforce:records: #[output application/java --- [{ Subject: "Integration failed: " ++ vars.businessErrorCode, WhatId: vars.oppId, OwnerId: vars.enriched[0].OwnerId, Description: vars.reason500, Status: "Not Started", Priority: "High" }]]

logger.doc:name: Log Task Result
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "TASK RESULT corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId): " ++ write(vars.sfTaskResult, "application/json")]

db:update.doc:name: Save Task id
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE order_exception SET sf_task_id = :taskId WHERE correlation_id = :correlationId AND opportunity_id = :opportunityId

logger.doc:name: Log Business Error Handled
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "BUSINESS ERROR HANDLED corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId) code=$(vars.businessErrorCode)"]

logger.doc:name: Log Business Error Handling Failed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- "BUSINESS ERROR HANDLING FAILED corr=$(vars.corrId) opp=$(vars.oppId): " ++ (error.description default "unknown")]

logger.doc:name: Log No Watermark
logger.message: WATERMARK not found - starting fresh

logger.doc:name: Log Resume
logger.message: #["WATERMARK found - resuming after $(payload)"]
